newsitem.title: USA: Carolina Harris nuke seen at 100 pct Tues.
newsitem.headline: Carolina Harris nuke seen at 100 pct Tues.

text.p: Carolina Power & Light Co's 880 megawatt Harris nuclear power plant was expected to reach full production Tuesday after cutting output for a feedwater pump repair, a company spokesman said.
"In less than 24 hours we should be back at 100 percent," spokesman Mike Hughes said Monday.
The unit was reduced to about 50 percent power over the weekend to repair a leak in one of two main feedwater pumps at the New Hill, N.C., plant.
